# CLI and output writers

Build the CLI interface and output writers (JSON schema + Markdown report) that produce deterministic, versioned output.

## Parent AC coverage

This task covers **AC2 (clusters reported with location and score)** — test_duplicates.json versioned schema (thresholds, method, limitations, clusters) and test_duplicate_report.md human-readable report (same content, ordered by redundancy). Each cluster lists member file paths, start-end line ranges, block sizes (lines and tokens), member-to-member and cluster similarity scores, and redundancy measure. Also covers **AC4 (performance bounds)** — scope options --changed-only <base-ref> (git diff), --max-files N, --min-lines N, --threshold, --min-shared-tokens documented; measured runtime figure for a ~500-test-file suite recorded in report preamble.

## Acceptance Criteria

- AC1 - Clusters are reported with location and score. Each cluster lists every member's file path, start-end line range, block size (lines and tokens), member-to-member and cluster similarity score, and a redundancy measure (member lines minus the largest member's lines) used to order the report. Both test_duplicates.json (versioned schema: thresholds, method, limitations, clusters) and test_duplicate_report.md (human, same content, ordered by redundancy) are written to --output-dir.
- AC2 - Performance is bounded and documented. Defaults skip trivial blocks (--min-lines, default 10) and bound the candidate set; comparison uses an inverted shingle index plus optional MinHash banding rather than all-pairs O(n^2). Scope options --changed-only <base-ref> (git diff), --max-files N, --min-lines N, --threshold and --min-shared-tokens are documented with the complexity they imply, and a measured runtime figure for a ~500-test-file suite is recorded in the docs and in the report preamble.
- AC3 - CLI accepts: --project-root, --output-dir, --changed-only <base-ref>, --max-files N, --min-lines N, --threshold, --min-shared-tokens, --quiet. Shaped like the churn analyser CLI.
- AC4 - --changed-only <base-ref> uses git diff to scope to changed test files only.
- AC5 - test_duplicates.json written with versioned schema: version number, thresholds used, method description, limitations, clusters array.
- AC6 - test_duplicate_report.md written with human-readable report: preamble with method, thresholds, limitations, measured runtime; clusters ordered by redundant lines; each cluster lists members with file path and line range.
- AC7 - Each cluster in output lists: member file paths, start-end line ranges, block sizes (lines and tokens), member-to-member similarity scores, cluster similarity score, redundancy measure.
- AC8 - Output is deterministic: same tree and flags produce byte-identical JSON; non-deterministic sources (file system order) are sorted.
- AC9 - A one-line summary printed to stderr: N blocks found, M clusters, K redundant lines.
- AC10 - Unit tests cover: JSON schema content and version, Markdown content matches JSON data, deterministic output (run twice produces identical files), --changed-only filtering, --max-files limiting, --threshold variation, and empty/single-block suite output.

## Deliverables

- skill/test-churn/scripts/test_duplicate_detection.py - CLI args, write_json_report(), write_md_report(), main()
- skill/test-churn/tests/test_test_duplicate_detection.py - CLI and output tests

## Key Files

- skill/test-churn/scripts/test_duplicate_detection.py - parse_args(), build_cli_parser(), write_json_report(), write_md_report(), main()
- skill/test-churn/tests/test_test_duplicate_detection.py - CLI and output writer tests

## Dependencies

- SA-0MWIT1LN00099MIT (classification and clustering)

# Comprehensive test suite

Write the full test suite covering all documented behaviour, with fixture suites and end-to-end runs.

## Parent AC coverage

This task covers **AC5 (behaviour pinned by tests)** — unit tests cover normalisation invariance (renamed copy scores >= threshold), distinct behaviour below band, expected-repetition exclusion for parametrised and table-driven cases, threshold boundary behaviour, cluster ordering and redundant-line arithmetic, JSON and Markdown schema/content, empty/single-block suite, non-Python file set, and one end-to-end run over a fixture suite. Every test asserts one documented behaviour and no test re-implements the similarity algorithm under test. Also covers **AC7 (full project test suite passes)** — the new tests integrate with the project test suite and all existing tests continue to pass.

## Acceptance Criteria

- AC1 - Behaviour is pinned by tests. Unit tests cover: normalisation invariance (a copy with renamed identifiers still scores >= threshold), distinct behaviour staying below the band, expected-repetition exclusion for parametrised and table-driven cases, threshold boundary behaviour, cluster ordering and redundant-line arithmetic, JSON and Markdown schema/content, an empty or single-block suite, a non-Python file set, and one end-to-end run over a fixture suite. Every test asserts one documented behaviour and no test re-implements the similarity algorithm under test.
- AC2 - Full project test suite must pass with the new changes.
- AC3 - End-to-end test: one run over a fixture suite that contains known duplicates, near-duplicates, expected repetition, and distinct tests; verify correct classification, clustering, and output.
- AC4 - .pi/test-config.json gains a test-churn group covering skill/test-churn/** (if optional within scope).
- AC5 - test-churn/tests/conftest.py loads test_duplicate_detection by path (same pattern as churn analyser).
- AC6 - Unit tests cover: normalisation invariance (a copy with renamed identifiers still scores >= threshold), distinct behaviour staying below the band, expected-repetition exclusion for parametrised and table-driven cases, threshold boundary behaviour, cluster ordering and redundant-line arithmetic, JSON and Markdown schema/content, an empty or single-block suite, a non-Python file set.

## Deliverables

- skill/test-churn/tests/test_test_duplicate_detection.py - comprehensive unit + e2e tests
- .pi/test-config.json - test-churn group (optional)
- skill/test-churn/tests/conftest.py - path-loaded fixture for test_duplicate_detection

## Key Files

- skill/test-churn/tests/test_test_duplicate_detection.py - all unit and e2e tests
- .pi/test-config.json - test-churn group
- skill/test-churn/tests/conftest.py - fixture loader

## Dependencies

- SA-0MWIT271W007DAVS (CLI and output writers)
